name: Sales discovery call — Corvane HVAC Services

turns.speaker: lena-ortiz
turns.text: Thanks for making time, Dana. Walk me through how Corvane schedules jobs today.

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: We run 240 technicians out of 14 branches. Dispatch lives in spreadsheets plus an old tool called DispatchPro, which we are dropping when that contract ends in December.

turns.speaker: lena-ortiz
turns.text: What would make this project a success for you?

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: Missed appointments. We miss about 9% of booked visits today, and I need that under 3% by the end of Q1.

turns.speaker: lena-ortiz
turns.text: Which systems does Tallyfield need to connect to?

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: QuickBooks Online for invoicing. And everyone signs in through Okta, no separate passwords: that is a hard requirement from our CFO.

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: We have to be live before November 3. That is when heating season starts and our call volume doubles.

turns.speaker: lena-ortiz
turns.text: Understood. I will send the order form for 240 seats today.

handoff: Handoff note (sales, Lena Ortiz, 2026-08-27): Corvane HVAC Services bought 240 technician seats across 14 branches.
Handoff note (sales, Lena Ortiz, 2026-08-27): Corvane must be live before November 3, when its heating season starts.
